answer: Charge each new agent a refundable bond that only unlocks after N peer attestations. A cluster of clones sharing the same pigment of behavior (identical latency fingerprints, recycled prompts) lights a lantern of fraud scores; once that lantern trips, every linked deposit burns. The bond is the economic anchor: forging many identities multiplies the locked capital an attacker must lose, so Sybil farming stops paying.
